findings.title: Known signs, counter-verdict, and ruin
findings.claim: Moses makes the signs a matter of Pharaoh's acknowledged knowledge and names the result as ruin. The wider sign narrative turns this into a question of response: denial accompanies inward certainty, Pharaoh's 'I think him a liar' is answered by Moses's 'I think you ruined,' and the attempt to expel others ends in reversal. A later audience's prostration leaves another response to the same disclosure visible.
findings.mechanism: عَلِمْتَ and بَصَائِرَ place knowledge and insight-producing proof before أَظُنُّكَ مَثْبُورًا. The supplied 27:14 parallel joins rejection of signs to inward certainty; 40:37 repeats Pharaoh's assessment formula while pairing his blocked course with a failed plot. The nine-sign frame in 17:101/27:12 and the wider denials of descent make أَنزَلَ a claim about dispatched evidence. The passive ruin predicate is then realized by drowning and territorial reversal, while 17:107 records prostration on recitation. Together these contacts let the final verdict answer a dispute over how known signs are received.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why Moses's verdict follows the assertion of knowledge: the signs are understood, yet responses divide between refusal and submission. The echoed assessment makes the closing judgment a counter-verdict, and the ruin word opens onto both a blocked course and an enacted outcome.
findings.containment: The focus remains Moses's emphatic speech: it states Pharaoh's knowledge and assesses him as ruined. The wider parallels do not establish Pharaoh's private motive or prove that the accusation of magic was consciously deceptive. Both the strong-assessment and conjectural readings of ظن remain available; the latter is not transferred from the speakers of 45:24 to Moses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: عَلِمْتَ is Moses's direct assertion that Pharaoh knows.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wide-walk summary places nine clear signs and the magic accusation at 17:101; 27:14 states that signs are denied while inward certainty remains.
branch_activations.activation: The focus puts acknowledged knowledge before the verdict, and the wider denial-with-certainty relation makes that knowledge bear on Pharaoh's response to the signs.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The exchange reads as a response to recognized evidence, with refusal carrying culpability.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not establish Pharaoh's private motive or prove that every earlier accusation was consciously deceptive.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: بَصَائِرَ names the signs as insight-producing proofs.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:104 calls the arriving proofs بصائر and contrasts seeing with blindness; 27:13 presents the signs as visible before 27:14 pairs their rejection with inward certainty.
branch_activations.activation: These wider surfaces make the focus's بصائر do inward cognitive work: the signs can be understood even where the response refuses them.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The signs carry an inner-comprehension dimension alongside their public evidentiary force.
branch_activations.boundary: The wider verses are parallels, not proof that every hearer received the signs in the same way.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bu iç kavrayış delil, kanıt, ibret ve açıklayıcı bildirim anlamlarına uzanır.
branch_activations.carrier: بَصَائِرَ predicates the signs as proofs and disclosures.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:104 repeats بصائر as proofs from the Lord; 28:43 calls Moses's Book بصائر for people after earlier generations were destroyed.
branch_activations.activation: The wider uses join proof to both personal seeing and lessons made legible through remembered judgment, deepening the focus's signs beyond spectacle.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's proofs can be heard as insight and as lessons whose force becomes visible in history.
branch_activations.boundary: This extension remains attached to the focus word's proof sense; it does not make the focus a reference to the specific events in 28:43.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Tanrısal iyilik, ceza veya bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı iyilikleri veya cezaları insanlara verir ve ulaştırır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَنزَلَ is the transitive dispatch of the demonstrative 'these' signs.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The packet places a finite nine-sign frame at 17:101/27:12, a parallel descent-as-clear-signs formula at 22:16, denial of any descent at 36:15, and prostration on recitation at 17:107.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's exclusive source claim meets wider disputes over whether anything was sent and a parallel account of signs being sent clearly; the finite sign set and contrasting reception make the dispatch purposeful evidence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The signs arrive as a commissioned disclosure whose reception is itself at issue.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supports divine dispatch and a finite sign set, not a sequential order of delivery or a shared target-side morphological analysis.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: belirtiye dayanıp kesin bilgiye varan güçlü inanış
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnanış bir belirtiye dayanır ve bu belirtinin gücüyle bilgi düzeyine ulaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَظُنُّ is Moses's assessment verb after the asserted knowledge and proof clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 27:14 sets rejection beside inward certainty; 40:37 repeats Pharaoh's emphatic أظنه formula in a counter-accusation.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's preceding knowledge and proofs supply the indicator for a strong assessment, while the wider echo turns the assessment into a mirrored verdict.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's judgment is forceful and evidence-grounded while remaining phrased as an assessment.
branch_activations.boundary: This branch does not erase the conjectural branch of ظن or make the focus an unqualified statement of certain knowledge.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi bir şey hakkında kesin bilgiye ulaşmadan kuşkulu bir inanış taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَظُنُّ retains the focus word's assessment form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 45:24 contrasts lack of knowledge with يظنون, supplying a wider conjectural use of the same assessment field.
branch_activations.activation: The wider contrast keeps a less-than-certain assessment audible in the focus even as its preceding knowledge and proof clauses strengthen Moses's judgment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The verdict can remain a forceful conjectural assessment rather than collapsing into either certainty or mere guesswork.
branch_activations.boundary: The lack of knowledge in 45:24 belongs to that passage's speakers and is not transferred to Moses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dayanak olan belirti çok zayıfsa inanış kuruntu sınırını aşamaz.
branch_activations.carrier: أَظُنُّ is the focus's personal assessment, attached to Pharaoh as object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 45:24 explicitly places conjecture where knowledge is absent.
branch_activations.activation: That wider counter-reading marks the boundary of the assessment sense: it may be conjectural, but the focus's acknowledged signs and emphatic frame give it a different evidentiary setting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The wording preserves an open interval between emphatic judgment and certainty without making the two uses identical.
branch_activations.boundary: No ranking of the B001 and B003 readings is made; the focus context remains controlling.

findings.title: Cosmic lordship as provision
findings.claim: The title 'Lord of the heavens and earth' can also carry a wider image of nurture: the sky-to-earth relation becomes visible as provision that brings growth.
findings.mechanism: The focus places Rabb in a construct with the heavens and the earth. In 20:53, earth is made a resting place, water comes down from the sky, and plants are brought forth. That concrete provision scene returns through the focus's Rabb and sky-earth relation, activating the nurturing facet of Rabb and the rain-from-above facet of the sky word.
findings.reader_payoff: The cosmic pair becomes a visible field of care: water from above reaches the earth and becomes growth, giving the title a sustaining contour alongside its authority.
findings.containment: The focus continues to name the Lord of both realms. The wider verse supplies a contextual image, not a word-for-word gloss, and no water meaning is assigned directly to Rabb.

epistemic.reason: 20:53 supplies the exact sky-water-growth scene, but the packet describes its link to 17:102 as general and supplies no target morphology. The branch contact is therefore retained as a bounded exploratory resonance.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 20:53 describes earth made a resting place, water sent from the sky, and plants brought forth.
branch_activations.activation: The wider sequence makes the focus's lordship concrete through provision and growth, fitting the root's nurturing facet without displacing the title's ordinary force.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rabb can be heard with an active sustaining relation to the earth's growth.
branch_activations.boundary: 20:53 does not use Rabb; this is a thematic contextual resonance, not a direct lexical equivalence.

branch_activations.activation: The upper domain named in the focus returns as the source side of a provision scene, making the sky-earth relation active rather than only spatial.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The heavens can be heard as the upper source from which provision reaches the earth.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus still names the heavens as a cosmic domain; the target scene does not define the focus noun.

branch_activations.activation: The rain facet meets the wider sky-water relation and lets the focus's upper domain resonate as the source of life-giving provision.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sky-earth pairing gains a contained rain-and-growth image.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual extension of the sky image; the focus does not itself name rain.

The focus's ظن remains open between B001's strong assessment and B003's conjecture. 27:14 supports refusal alongside certainty, while 45:24 preserves a conjectural counter-reading; neither context settles the focus verb.
The ثبر B003 blocking overlay is a qualified contextual extension: 40:37 and 7:137 supply its wider trigger, while the focus's core ruin predicate remains intact.

The proposed سمو/وسم physical-mark analogy has no supplied trace returning through السماوات and no independent physical-mark trigger. The 20:53 sky/rain connection remains exploratory and does not establish abundant gathered water or an etymological link.
